meta.title: Shipping & Payment | Padel2Go
meta.description: Shipping costs, delivery times, payment methods and returns in the PADEL2GO shop.

header.title: Shipping & Payment
header.subtitle: Everything about delivery, payment methods and returns in the PADEL2GO shop

items.label: Shipping costs:
items.text: Shipping within Germany is free of charge. All product prices include statutory VAT.

items.label: Delivery area:
items.text: We currently deliver within Germany only.

items.label: Delivery time:
items.text: Unless stated otherwise for the respective product, the delivery time is 2–4 business days after receipt of payment.

items.label: Order confirmation:
items.text: After completing your order, you will receive an order confirmation by email with all the details of your order.

payment.heading: Payment Methods

items.label: Card:
items.text: Visa, Mastercard and American Express – processed securely via our payment service provider Stripe.

items.label: PayPal:
items.text: Pay with your PayPal account, also processed via Stripe.

items.label: P2G Points:
items.text: Registered users can pay up to 50% of the order value with P2G Points (100 points = €1.00 discount). Details in our Terms (§ 8).

payment.note: All payments are SSL-encrypted and processed via Stripe. We do not store any card data.

returns.heading: Withdrawal & Returns
returns.p1Prefix: As a consumer, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal for purchases of goods, starting upon receipt of the goods. All details and the model withdrawal form can be found in our
returns.p2: We cover the cost of the return shipment. Simply notify us of your withdrawal by email to contact@padel2go.eu – we will then send you all the information for the return.
returns.p3: The refund will be made within 14 days of receipt of your withdrawal to the original payment method; redeemed P2G Points will be credited back to your account.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.text: If you have any questions about your order, you can reach us at any time at contact@padel2go.eu.
